newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel dips as refiners dump product.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel dips as refiners dump product.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices slipped on Thursday as refiners off-loaded product on the market to free storage, traders said.
Two European refiners were heard offering low sulphur material at $104 fob and a 30,000 tonne cargo was heard traded on Wednesday at $114 cif to a destination on the Mediterranean coast of France.
Refiners with more tank space and outlets in the bunker market for straight run blended with high sulphur fuel oil were offering material at $108 fob.
"Cargoes were dumped because of a storage crisis," said one trader, adding that a lack of appropriate shipping to satisfy U.S. interest exacerbated the problem.
"The price has blipped down on that technical basis despite strong crude futures but it should recover."
